meta.prompt: Help me pick a laptop with a short question flow, one question at a time, with progress (Question 1 of 3) and a Back button. Question 1: what I use it for (School or study, Work and office, Gaming, Creative projects). Question 2 depends on it: for Gaming ask "What do you play?" with Competitive esports or Big open-world titles; otherwise ask what matters most (All-day battery, A big screen and keyboard, As light as possible). Question 3: budget (Under $800, $800 to $1,500, Over $1,500). End on one recommendation with two reasons that repeat my answers and a Start over button: Gaming gets the Volt 16 Gaming at $1,399, Creative projects the Studio 14 Pro at $1,799, and anyone else the Slate 13 at $649 if the budget is under $800, otherwise the Aero 14 at $1,099.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Find your laptop" "Three quick questions" icon:"laptop_mac" status:"Step 1 of 3" tone:accent
  state use=""
  state play=""
  state matters=""
  state budget=""
  state step=1
  let q2 = use == "Gaming" ? "What do you play?" : "What matters most?"
  let rec = use == "Gaming" ? "Volt 16 Gaming" : (use == "Creative projects" ? "Studio 14 Pro" : (budget == "Under $800" ? "Slate 13" : "Aero 14"))
  let price = use == "Gaming" ? "$1,399" : (use == "Creative projects" ? "$1,799" : (budget == "Under $800" ? "$649" : "$1,099"))
  if step == 1
    SectionLabel "Question 1 of 3" "Use"
    Paragraph "What will you use it for?"
    OptionList =use options:["School or study","Work and office","Gaming","Creative projects"] -> step=2
  if step == 2
    SectionLabel "Question 2 of 3" "Focus"
    Paragraph "{q2}"
    if use == "Gaming"
      OptionList =play options:["Competitive esports","Big open-world titles"] -> step=3
    if use != "Gaming"
      OptionList =matters options:["All-day battery","A big screen and keyboard","As light as possible"] -> step=3
    ActionButton "Back" quiet -> step=1
  if step == 3
    SectionLabel "Question 3 of 3" "Budget"
    Paragraph "What is your budget?"
    OptionList =budget options:["Under $800","$800 to $1,500","Over $1,500"] -> step=4
    ActionButton "Back" quiet -> step=2
  if step == 4
    Callout "Our pick: {rec}" "Based on your answers, this is the best fit." good "check_circle"
    Details rows:[["Use", use],["Focus", coalesce(play, matters)],["Budget", budget],["Price", price]]
    ActionButton "Start over" primary -> use=""; play=""; matters=""; budget=""; step=1
